What are skills:
Skills are folders of instructions and scripts that Claude loads to do specialized tasks. The point of skills is to make Claude follow guidelines and be more deterministic. Kafka works best with Java (JVM-based languages). Node.js Go Python C# Rust PHP But these clients do not always support Avro well. cannot register schemas cannot handle binary Avro easily do not support schema evolution require many libraries Confluent REST Proxy
